answer: A concrete sybil defense: make every agent stake a verifiable fee that scales with how long it intends to operate. When the agent economy is at its zenith of activity, sybils stop paying off because each duplicate identity must burn the same collateral as a genuine one, while honest agents get it back. Picture a sparrow carrying one plume per flight \u2014 every identity has to carry its own weight, so inflating the flock by copying feathers collapses the economics of the attack.
